Vowles continued to be a dynamic dignitary in the sport of athletics until at least his eightieth year and we are sure that were he alive today, he would be proud of the contribution his clubmen have made in forming part of a team that has reached the highest levels of our sport. ARM

Vowles - 'The Grand Old Man of Athletics', but I would take ARM to task when he states at the end of the article that "were Mr. Vowles alive today he would be proud of the contribution his clubmen have made in forming part of a team ... etc., etc."
His 14:36 took him straight up to third spot on the all-time top 20 list behind Gerry North's epic 14:15 in 1962 and Ollie Foote's 14:34 from 1984 - and he's just 17 years old! ARM
